description: Find Asana tasks by name, within one matter (matter_id) or across the firm's Asana (top 20 matches). Sign-in required.

matter_id.description: Matter identifier from find_matter or list_open_matters. Searches only that matter's tasks. Omit to search the firm's Asana.

query.description: Text to match in task names.

name: search_tasks
title: Search Asana tasks
